posts.text:
Chris does good pushback but the ease with which Tucker has swallowed Russian disinformation is startling. Zero recognition of Putin launching a war of territorial aggression that has killed or wounded hundreds of thousands of Ukrainians and even more of his own people, characterizing murderous authoritarianism as smart “politics”, falsely claiming many Ukrainians have willingly fled east when they have quite deliberately fled west, the list goes on.


Joshua Reed Eakle 🗽 (@JoshEakle)

Chris Cuo
